name: Content scaling: an item's market value follows the item level it was scaled to
contract: Requires CoAContentScaling.Enable=1 with the TBC and WotLK packs at cap 60. Whoever prices goods by their
vendor value - the auction house bots - asks LocalLevelScaling for the item's worth on this realm, and the
content scaling module moves the authored vendor price along the vendor prices of items of the same kind
from the authored to the scaled item level. Runecloth 14047 (item level 50, 267 copper) and Frostweave Cloth
33470 (item level 70, 833 copper) are both moved down and keep their order: Frostweave is still worth more,
but less than its vendor price, which stays 833. Medallion of the Disgraced 39470, an epic neck of item level
200 selling for 47497 copper, falls to a small part of it. The Centenarian Bullion 413799 is a custom item
whose price was set by hand; its worth stays its vendor price of 50 gold.
